data.body_html:
New Year's Eve 2036 in Marbella is the kind of night you remember for decades. The sky explodes over Puerto Banús, the harbour fills with superyachts, and every restaurant on the Golden Mile is packed. But the best seat in the house isn't on land — it's on the water. A Marbella boat rental for NYE 2036 gives you uninterrupted views of the fireworks, a private party space, and zero crowds. Here's everything you need to know to book the perfect boat for the night.

Why Watch NYE Fireworks from a Boat in Marbella?

Marbella's NYE fireworks are launched from a barge in Puerto Banús harbour. From land, you're competing for space along the promenade, fighting queues at bars, and dealing with traffic. From a boat, you anchor 100–200 metres offshore and watch the show reflected in the water. No jostling, no noise, no hassle. You control the music, the drinks, and the company.

Best Boats for NYE 2036 Fireworks Viewing

Our fleet of 18 boats ranges from 6.4m speedboats to 29m luxury yachts. For NYE, the most popular choices are:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) — €749 for 2 hours. Perfect for couples or small groups. Departs Puerto Banús.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) — €749 for 2 hours. Same price, slightly more capacity. Great for families.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) — €4,719 for 4 hours (minimum). Includes a free jet ski and a flybridge for panoramic views.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) — pricing on request via WhatsApp. The ultimate luxury option with a sundeck and saloon.

All boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. You just bring your party spirit.

For NYE, we recommend a 2-hour slot from 23:00 to 01:00 for Tier A boats, or a 4-hour charter for larger yachts to enjoy pre-fireworks cruising along the coast.

Best Anchor Spots for NYE Fireworks in Marbella

The fireworks are launched from Puerto Banús harbour. The best anchor positions are:

  • Outside the harbour mouth — 50–100m off the breakwater. Direct view of the launch barge.
  • Cala del Faro — a small cove just west of Puerto Banús. Calmer waters, great backdrop.
  • Off the Golden Mile — slightly further out, but you see the fireworks over the marina skyline.

Your skipper will know the best spot based on wind and tide conditions on the night.

What to Expect on NYE 2036 in Marbella

Marbella's NYE weather averages 14–18°C — mild enough to enjoy the deck, but bring a jacket. The fireworks start at midnight and last 10–15 minutes. After the show, you can cruise back to Puerto Banús or anchor for a nightcap. Most boats return to port by 01:00–01:30. The marina stays lively until 03:00.

How to Book Your NYE Boat in Marbella

NYE is the busiest night of the year. Our fleet books out weeks in advance. To secure your preferred boat, contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred boat, group size, and time slot. We'll confirm availability and send you a booking link. Payment is required in advance to hold the slot.
